description: Main-character progression model. Capability never rises for free; the engine debits a cost track for every credit on a capability track.

craft.label: Technical mastery of the world's core discipline

authority.label: Institutional and social power to make others act

insight.label: Reading people, systems, and hidden structure

endurance.label: What the body and nerve can absorb

reach.label: Geographic and political scope of action

integrity.label: Alignment between stated and actual values

anonymity.label: How invisible the MC still is to powers that matter

lie_grip.label: How firmly the MC's controlling lie still holds. Falls as the arc lands.

self_knowledge.label: Rises as lie_grip falls. Mirror track.

exchange_rules: Any +1 on a capability track requires -1 on at least one cost track, chosen on the page, not in summary.
lie_grip may only fall after an on-page refusal, failure, or confrontation. Never from reflection alone.
self_knowledge = 10 - lie_grip, enforced by the engine.
A capability track may not exceed its start value plus (chapter_number / 6), rounded down, before Act III. Growth is rationed, not the baseline.
No track moves in a rest chapter except intimacy and body, which may recover by 1.

gates.name: Admitted to the discipline
gates.on_page: Must be earned in a scene of tested competence, witnessed.

gates.name: The compromise
gates.on_page: MC must choose it knowingly. No accident, no coercion.

gates.name: The lie breaks
gates.on_page: Confrontation with the person who benefits from the lie.

development_spine.want: To be indispensable enough that no one can discard them again.
development_spine.need: To be known by someone who has the power to leave and stays anyway.
development_spine.lie: Worth is a balance you must keep positive, and love is the interest paid on it.
development_spine.truth: A ledger cannot hold a person. Some things are given, not earned.
development_spine.ghost: Traded away at eleven to settle a family debt, and told it was an honor.
development_spine.final_state: Keeps the competence, drops the accounting. Chooses one unearned loyalty in public.
